subject: social
name: Social Studies
title: Grade 1 Social Studies: Families Through Time & Community Leaders
overview: Grade 1 Social Studies builds civic competence, geographical literacy, economic understanding, and historical inquiry aligned with the C3 Framework.
competencies: Investigate historical questions using multiple primary and secondary sources.
Analyze human and physical geography to understand how location and resources shape human decisions.
Explain economic concepts including production, market exchange, trade specialization, and public finance.
Apply democratic principles and civic virtues to deliberate contemporary public issues.

modules.title: Families and Communities Through Time
modules.description: Comparing everyday life in the past with life today, examining family structures, schools, transport, and technology.

topics.title: Daily Life: Past vs. Present
topics.description: Comparing communication, schoolhouses, chores, and games across generations.

topics.title: Historical Timelines & Family Artifacts
topics.description: Creating visual timelines and analyzing historical photographs and family heirlooms.

modules.title: Community Leadership & Democratic Voice
modules.description: Learning how local town councils, mayors, and voting work, and how citizens resolve disagreements fairly.

topics.title: Leaders in Our Town, State & Nation
topics.description: Identifying roles of principal, mayor, governor, and president in leadership.

topics.title: Voting and Fair Decision Making
topics.description: Conducting classroom elections and practicing consensus building.
